title: Perjalanan Sunyi di Bawah Kilau Neon
theme: Menemukan arti dari sebuah perjalanan malam yang tak terduga, membangkitkan kenangan masa lalu yang menenangkan dan proses penerimaan diri.

cover.prompt: Early morning hours, just before dawn, on a quiet residential street. The soft glow of a distant street lamp gently illuminates a path. The silhouette of a lone figure stands at the threshold of a modest home, framed by the warm, inviting light spilling from an ajar wooden door. A subtle haze softens the air, creating a tranquil, introspective atmosphere, suggesting a gentle wandering into the quiet pre-dawn.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: A retired newspaper vendor, Pak Hardi, embarks on a sleepless night walk through a quiet city. His journey takes him past old haunts, evoking poignant memories and a sense of growing solitude, yet also a quiet curiosity. Under a rarely-used overpass, he discovers a faded mural depicting a bustling traditional market. A specific figure in the mural, Pak Rahman, triggers deep, bittersweet recollections of his early days in the city and formative guidance. Returning home at dawn, Pak Hardi finds a newfound serenity and acceptance of his life's path, having reconciled with his past through this unexpected urban pilgrimage.
